purpose: ids-input Qwen3.5 VL decoder (S=1, fresh zero states, loop-free GDN step, in-graph M-RoPE, fp32 CPU eager) vs the author's fp32 oracle on every fixture run

harness.depthwise_conv: evaluated as torch.bmm (no oneDNN in this torch build); checked against F.conv1d with torch.equal (all channels, all linear layers) at the last slot step of every run

oracle.oracle: checkpoint decider/vision.py VisionDecisionModel.prepare() -> slot_logits(), fp32, CPU, torch.no_grad
oracle.image_embeds: oracle npz image_embeds (HF fp32 tower output), zero-padded to 256 rows

contract.image: ids <|image_pad|> -> V + k (row-major), image_rc[k] = (k // W, k % W), start = index of <|vision_end|> = 1 + H*W, amount = H*W - max(H, W)
contract.readout: logits at every slot step of one S=1 pass, letters ids 32..41, softmax(T=1) over the first nopts

trimmed.serialization: compact json (no indentation) to keep the repository small; the full copy is pretty-printed
